{{Ice hockey at the 1998 Winter Olympics}}
{{Main|Ice hockey at the 1998 Winter Olympics}}

These are the '''team rosters''' of the nations that participated in the '''[[Ice hockey at the 1998 Winter Olympics – Women's tournament|women's ice hockey tournament]] of the [[1998 Winter Olympics]]'''.

''Ages and clubs listed as of the start of the tournament, 8 February 1998.''

==Canada==
{{See also|Canada at the 1998 Winter Olympics|Canada women's national ice hockey team}}
<section begin=CAN />The Canadian roster was announced on 9 December, 1997.<ref>{{cite web|title=CANADIAN HOCKEY ANNOUNCES WOMEN'S OLYMPIC HOCKEY TEAM ROSTER|url=https://www.hockeycanada.ca/en-ca/news/1997-nr-136-en|date=December 9, 1997|publisher=[[Hockey Canada]]|access-date=October 24, 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Team Canada 1998 Winter Olympic Roster|url=http://www.whockey.com/country/canada/roster/1998.html|date=December 9, 1997|website=whockey.com|accessdate=October 24, 2023}}</ref>
